data.name: Shivkumar
data.gender_notes: Shivkumar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: God Shiva, Lord of Destruction and Transformation
data.long_meaning: Shivkumar is a combination of two Sanskrit words: Shiva, the destroyer of evil and creator of the universe, and Kumar, meaning young or prince. This name carries the power and strength of Lord Shiva, making it an ideal choice for a child who is destined for greatness and transformation. The name Shivkumar carries the meaning “God Shiva, Lord of Destruction and Transformation” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Shivkumar usually hope their child will grow to embody god shiva, lord of destruction and transformation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who seek the power and protection of Lord Shiva, and a reminder of the destructive and transformative power within each of us.
data.etymology: Shivkumar belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God Shiva, Lord of Destruction and Transformation.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shivkumar total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Shivkumar is derived from Hinduism, a rich and ancient culture that influences millions of people around the world. Shivkumar honors the deity Lord Shiva, who represents the ultimate reality, extinguisher of evil, and the giver of boons to his devotees. This name is not just a title, but a bond between the person holding it and the supreme power of Lord Shiva.
data.spiritual_significance: Shivkumar is a powerful spiritual name that signifies the divine blessings of Lord Shiva. It invokes a sense of grace, reverence, and strength, enabling the bearer to remain grounded and centered in both spiritual and practical matters. This name is believed to remind the person of their spiritual connection to the universe and innate potential for greatness. Furthermore, it carries the blessings of Lord Shiva, which includes wisdom, strength, and protection during challenging times.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Shivkumar is a name that embodies the divine blend of Shiva, the destroyer and transformer, and Kumar, meaning young or son. This name signifies the inner transformation and destruction of negative emotions, leading to spiritual growth and enlightenment as a young warrior on the path of righteousness.

historical_references.reference: Shivkumar was a title given to Shiva, the Hindu god of destruction and regeneration. This title suggests a union of Shiva and Vishnu, whose names suggest 'universal consciousness' and 'preserver', respectively. This union signifies the cyclical nature of the universe: destruction leads to preservation, and preservation leads to destruction.
historical_references.time_period: Ancient India, circa 2nd millennium BCE - present day

historical_references.reference: Shivkumar is also the name of a famous Maratha king, Shivaji Bhonsle, who ruled the Maratha Empire from 1630 to 1680. This title was given to him as a mark of respect, reflecting his devotion to Shiva and his role as a powerful and just ruler.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Shivkumar, derived from Hindu mythology where Shiva is the deity of destruction and transformation, has seen a modern resurgence in various contexts. On professional networking site LinkedIn, individuals with this name may be seen in leadership roles within technology companies or in entrepreneurial ventures. Instagram is a popular platform for those with the name Shivkumar to showcase their spiritual practices, often featuring images of Hindu temples, deities, and rituals. On Twitter, the name Shivkumar is used in discussions related to Indian politics, technology trends, and spirituality. Overall, the name Shivkumar represents a blend of ancient spirituality, modern technology, and entrepreneurial spirit.
